segments.en: Hello.
Hello.
What's up? What are you doing? Are you sleeping?
Are you feeling sleepy during the day?
You sleep during the day, don't you?
Where do you sleep?
Okay.
Tell me, why do I feel good talking to you? Tell me.
I don't feel shy talking to you. I talk to you openly, just like we do.
Why do I feel shy with others?
Where did you go at that time?
At that time, I mean, I was in the hostel, and someone or the other comes by, really.
You know, I really like talking to you, really.
It feels like I should talk to you.
I want to get rid of my shyness by talking to you.
I will learn everything from you, okay?
Promise?
Okay.
How long has it been since you got married?
How long has it been since your marriage?
How long has it been since the marriage?
Yes.
It's been about six years.
How many children do you have? Tell me.
I have two children.
How many children?
Two.
Really? So how many years has it been since the marriage? Tell me, I like talking to you.
Yes, six years, six years. Tell me.
What's the matter?
Okay, so what do you wear in Delhi? Do you wear a suit or a saree? What do you wear?
Don't you feel shy asking such things?
I feel good talking to you. Like, when we talk on the phone, I don't feel shy. But when someone comes in front of me, I don't get that feeling.
That's it.
What do you mean?
Are you acting like a child?
What? What?
What are you saying?
No, I mean, when we talk on the phone, I don't feel shy. But if someone comes in front of me, I won't be able to do anything, really. I'm telling you that much.
Hmm.
Where is your husband? Is he on duty?
Leave all that. How are you?
Leave all that. How are you?
Oh, I'm fine. Tell me, how can I get rid of my shyness? Where should I go? To a massage parlor?
Will it go away if I go to a spa?
Shyness? Go and bathe in the Ganges.
Okay, so tell me how to proceed.
Listen, listen, listen.
Have you ever gone to bathe in the Ganges?
No, I haven't gone. I haven't gone anywhere.
Why?
How do I check? How do I check if I can do something with a girl? Tell me.
First, answer the questions I ask you.
I haven't gone anywhere to bathe in the Ganges.
Why didn't you go?
I haven't gone yet. Everyone will go, then I will go. It's not like that.
So, who are you taking with you?
My family will go. Should I go alone? I live in a hostel. I'm busy with my studies, really.
I don't think you are studying.
I live in a hostel, but what can I do? I have only one tension: why do I feel shy when someone comes? I've spent good times, but they left. I couldn't do anything.
I remember it.
I remember that they said something, and I didn't do anything. Tell me, how much shyness I feel.
They said so much, and I didn't do anything. I feel so much more now.
What's the problem? Being shy is a good thing, man.
Now that I'm married, I don't know if I'll be able to do anything with my wife or not.
Being shy is a good thing, it's not bad.
If someone says that you've seen everything, then assume that they will ask, "What else will you say?"
Come and sleep with me. They won't say that.
They are saying so much, and I haven't done anything. I'll know.
You say I won't be able to do anything. I saw it while bathing.
Why don't I have that feeling?
I'm worried about this.
It happens. It's the best thing. If you feel shy, it's a good thing. You should be shy.
You should have respect for elders.
You had a sister-in-law, right? She must be older than you in age and in deeds.
Assume that, God forbid, her mind was weak, but that's okay.
But at least you did your duty so that you don't do anything wrong with them.
What's better than that?
No, like, now that I'm married, I won't be able to do anything with my wife either, because I...
I'm worried about this.
If a girl comes, I won't be able to do anything. Because of shyness, I won't have any sexual desire.
That's how I am. How do I check if I can do something at a spa, at a massage parlor?
See, if your nature is not bad, then don't make your nature bad, okay?
Try to be good, it will feel good, and it will be good.
That's the biggest thing. And the rest...
